attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries. The Greek page settles what the folder's own life left open: its couplet for her, «Kομμωτικόν τι βάμμα νύμφη Kυρίου, Bάπτη Λιβύη δούσα την δέριν ξίφει», gives her neck to the sword, and its closing sentence makes the first of the three die by fire and the other two by the sword — the same way round as the «Livia și Leonida, cele două surori» the Romanian life of Fevronia recalls, where Livia was beheaded and Leonida thrown into the fire. The entry enumerates all three women by name, so it is one folder each, and Leonis and Eutropia are new folders in this batch. No year, no country and no persecutor are printed, so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
